title: MIST: A Co-Design Framework for Heterogeneous, Multi-Stage LLM Inference
authors: Abhimanyu Rajeshkumar Bambhaniya; Hanjiang Wu; Suvinay Subramanian; Sudarshan Srinivasan; Souvik Kundu; Amir Yazdanbakhsh; Midhilesh Elavazhagan; Madhu Kumar; Minlan Yu; Arijit Raychowdhury; Tushar Krishna
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Google, Intel, Intel Labs, Google DeepMind, Harvard University, Infravana
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, MoE serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, PD disaggregation, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Hardware co-design, GPU memory tiering

problem_statement.en: Modern LLM serving spans multi-stage pipelines (RAG retrieval, KV cache reuse, prefill, decode) with distinct compute, memory, and latency demands on increasingly heterogeneous hardware (GPUs, TPUs, ASICs), yet existing inference simulators model only single-stage serving on homogeneous clusters and cannot evaluate cross-vendor, prefill-decode disaggregated configurations end-to-end. Exhaustively benchmarking the resulting configuration space on real hardware (e.g. Llama-3-70B on 8xH100) can exceed 40,000 USD in cloud cost.
problem_statement.zh: 現代 LLM 服務跨越多階段 pipeline（RAG 檢索、KV cache 重用、prefill、decode），在 GPU、TPU、ASIC 等日益異質的硬體上各自具備不同的運算、記憶體與延遲需求；既有推理模擬器僅針對同質叢集上的單階段服務建模，無法端到端評估跨廠商、prefill-decode 解耦合的部署組態。直接在真實硬體上窮舉設定空間（例如 8xH100 上的 Llama-3-70B）可能耗費超過 40,000 美元的雲端成本。

key_innovation.en: An event-driven, end-to-end discrete-event simulation framework that models the full LLM serving stack across three layers (AI Workload, System & Software, Hardware) with pluggable accelerator models (real execution, empirical, analytical, or external simulator such as ASTRA-sim, AIConfigurator, and GenZ). MIST jointly captures multi-stage pipelines (RAG + KV retrieval + prefill + decode), heterogeneous multi-vendor PD-disaggregated configurations, batching policies (static / continuous / chunked / mixed / disaggregated), and tiered KV cache storage (HBM, DRAM, SSD, rack-shared) within one unified software stack.
key_innovation.zh: 一個事件驅動的端到端離散事件模擬框架，將完整 LLM 服務堆疊分為 AI Workload、System & Software、Hardware 三層，並支援可插拔的加速器模型（real execution、empirical、analytical、或 ASTRA-sim、AIConfigurator、GenZ 等外部模擬器）。MIST 在統一軟體堆疊內同時建模多階段 pipeline（RAG + KV retrieval + prefill + decode）、跨廠商異質 PD 解耦合組態、批次策略（static、continuous、chunked、mixed、disaggregated）與分層 KV cache 儲存（HBM、DRAM、SSD、rack-shared）。

key_improvements.en: End-to-end fidelity within 6% of real-hardware vLLM runs; less than 2% average error in aggregated validation against vLLM Llama-3-70B on H100x8, Qwen3-32B on L40Sx2, and Llama-3-8B on TPUv6e; 20-50x faster than real execution. MIST-optimized multi-vendor PD-disaggregated deployments yield up to 49.3% higher tokens-per-dollar than the best single-vendor homogeneous PD-disaggregated baseline.
key_improvements.zh: 端到端保真度在實機 vLLM 結果的 6% 之內；針對 H100x8 的 Llama-3-70B、L40Sx2 的 Qwen3-32B 與 TPUv6e 的 Llama-3-8B 進行聚合驗證時平均誤差小於 2%；模擬速度較實機快 20-50x。經 MIST 最佳化的跨廠商 PD 解耦合部署相較於最佳單廠商同質 PD 解耦合基線，每美元 token 吞吐可提升最高 49.3%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100-SXM, NVIDIA H200-SXM, NVIDIA B200-SXM, NVIDIA GB300, AMD MI350X, AMD MI355X, Google TPUv6e, Google TPUv7, Etched Sohu, NVIDIA L40S, HBM, DDR4, NVMe SSD
gpu_count: Up to 256 GPUs (4 racks of 64xH100 in KV storage study); 8x H100 / 80x H100 / 4x L40S / 1-2x TPUv6e in validation
node_count: Up to 4 HGX racks (64 GPUs each)
models_validated: Llama-3-70B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, Qwen3-32B, Bloom-176B, Llama-2-70B
validation_workloads: ShareGPT, Azure trace (Conv and Code), Narrative QA, Github-Code dataset, Synthetic Poisson arrivals

scope_assumptions.en: RAG retrieval modeled via empirical LangChain runtime on a 64-core x86 CPU; KV retrieval latency modeled via linear regression on profiled DDR4/NVMe data; KV Client and RAG Client clusters do not support analytical-model or external-simulator backends; output token counts are not predicted (taken as inputs); single-cluster pricing estimated from public cloud rates; the framework treats Splitwise-sim as a valid simulation-based baseline rather than real hardware at 80+ GPU scale.
scope_assumptions.zh: RAG 檢索採用 LangChain 在 64 核 x86 CPU 上的 empirical runtime 建模；KV retrieval 延遲以 profiled DDR4 與 NVMe 資料的線性回歸建模；KV Client 與 RAG Client 叢集不支援 analytical-model 或外部模擬器後端；輸出 token 數視為輸入而非預測量；單叢集價格採用公開雲端費率估算；在 80 GPU 以上規模時將 Splitwise-sim 視為合法的模擬基線而非實機驗證。
